subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Scope 1, 2, and 3 Emissions
description: A micro-lesson that makes Scope 1, 2, and 3 Emissions usable.

hook.text: A company's own factories emit 5% of its total carbon. The other 95% comes from suppliers and logistics.

buildup.text: Scope 1 is direct emissions. Scope 2 is purchased energy. Scope 3 is everything else in the value chain.

discovery.text: Scope 3 includes raw materials, transport, product use, and disposal—the largest and hardest to measure.

twist.text: Most companies report Scope 1 and 2 but avoid Scope 3 because measuring supplier emissions is extremely hard.

climax.text: New regulations will require Scope 3 reporting. Companies that start measuring now gain a head start.

punchline.text: Scope 3 is where most emissions hide. And it's huge.

quiz.question: What does Scope 3 cover?
options: All value chain emissions including suppliers and logistics
